events.title: Lost crank bolt found in multi-tool
events.summary: I was finally replacing the crank on my bike at Valik's apartment in Munich. I spent about half an hour hunting for the small bolt that locks the crank in place and got really angry at myself. It turned out I had tucked it in with my multi-tool for safekeeping, so I could finally put everything together.
events.quote: I put it, um, uh,  tucked it in with the rest of the stuff in my multi-tool
